en.headline: Lee orders one-month probe into Queen Mary Hospital lift faults
en.dek: The chief executive said contractors, subcontractors and, if involved, government staff would be held to account after lifts in the new clinical block failed to work properly.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday that problems with lifts in the new clinical block at Queen Mary Hospital must be corrected as quickly as possible so the building can open for clinical services.

Speaking before the Executive Council, Lee said the Development Bureau had given him a preliminary briefing and that he had asked it to establish the facts and submit a report within one month. He said responsibility would be pursued against contractors, subcontractors, works staff and professionals, and against government officers if they were involved.

Lee also said the government would look for gaps in the system and fix them promptly. The new block began opening in phases from November last year, but clinical services have remained limited while lift and other building systems undergo rectification.

The Architectural Services Department has previously said that of 28 lifts in the block, only four were regarded as acceptable during trial operation, and that the contractors had been told to complete remedial works at their own cost, with their eligibility to tender for public works suspended.

zh.headline: 李家超下令一個月內查清瑪麗醫院新樓升降機問題
zh.dek: 特首出席行政會議前表示，必須盡快糾正新臨床大樓升降機未能有效運作的問題，並追究承建商、分判商及如涉及的政府人員責任。
body: 行政長官李家超周二表示，瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機未能有效運作的問題必須盡快糾正，新大樓要盡快啟用，為市民提供醫療服務。
他出席行政會議前見記者時說，發展局已向他作初步匯報，他要求局方徹查真相，並於一個月內提交報告。當局會追究責任，包括承建商、分判商、工程人員及專業人士；如涉及政府人員，亦會追究，並查找制度不足，從速改善。
李家超指事件受廣泛關注，強調醫療服務十分重要，所以必須全速糾正。新大樓由去年11月起分階段啟用，但臨床服務仍未全面投入，有關升降機及其他系統仍在執修。
建築署早前表示，大樓28部升降機在試行期間僅4部情況屬尚可接受，已責成承建商及分判商承擔改善工程費用，並暫停他們參與工務工程投標，同時保留追究權利。
